WITH account_orders AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM "order"
  GROUP BY account_id
),
average_orders AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count
  FROM account_orders
)
SELECT ao.account_id, d.A3 AS region, ao.order_count,
       ao.order_count - avg.avg_count AS difference
FROM account_orders AS ao
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = ao.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
CROSS JOIN average_orders AS avg
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
